limits: Observed host RAF plus native ResizeObserver callback time, not whole-browser style/layout/paint, GPU elapsed, input latency or FPS. Getter/draw/clone figures are nested.
Mixed-scene A-yard/B-yard/B-Reservoir/A-Reservoir one pair per scene, not repeated same-scene ABBA or statistical significance.
Ready poses/ticks exact; native playback start ticks differ by one, final ticks match; no clock or input substitution.
No actual resize during the accepted timing windows: geometry transitions/disposal are independently covered by native functional matrix; their cost is not amortized into stable-window averages.
Browser-reported MacIntel/Chrome154/DPR2/14 logical CPUs; actual hardware and shared-process contention unverified.
Supported LoAF/longtask observers saw zero qualifying entries starting in the windows; absence is not absence of jank.
Academy display implementation and physical controller/mobile-device qualification remain separate. No ImageBitmap/heap/thermal claim.
Prior timing canvas change remains unexplained; successful fixed-size rerun does not fix or establish its cause.
